generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: All-new BEV based on the third-generation Nissan LEAF (CMF-EV): 75 kWh liquid-cooled lithium-ion pack (no 52 kWh option), native NACS DC port at up to 150 kW (10-80 % in about 35 min), separate J1772 AC port. North American launch fall 2026 as MY2027; EPA lists it (160 kW FWD). Likely shares a powertrain with the 2026+ LEAF 75 kWh. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.kbb.com/car-news/2027-mitsubishi-eclipse-sportback-ev-doubles-down-on-charge-doors/ ; https://electrek.co/2026/07/28/mitsubishi-eclipse-sportback-ev-rebadged-nissan-leaf/ ; https://mitsubishi-motors-pr.ca/mitsubishi-eclipse-sportback-ev-to-offer-multiple-charging-options/
